summary.text: Cassie Julia is a Democratic state representative from Maine who has represented District 65 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists her profession as small business growth consultant.

paragraphs.text: Cassie Julia assumed office in the Maine House of Representatives on December 3, 2024, succeeding Bruce White.
Ballotpedia describes her career experience as working as a small business growth consultant.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Leaves of Absence Committee.
